Pinned from https://github.com/egoist/mygo at `41ec785c253caacb03861dfa0a1099e670144c8f`.

The local change is an opt-in `Theme.ContinuousCorners` setting used by FlClash to keep continuous corners on every desktop platform. The renderer consults it for fills, clips, SVGs, images, shadows, materials and embedded-surface holes. Defaults remain those of upstream.

MyGo's license remains in `LICENSE`. Documentation and agent instructions are retained; npm workspace tooling, website and example apps are not shipped with this source snapshot.
